children: The S&P Global France Manufacturing PMI fell to 50.3 in September 2026 from 51.1 in August, marking a second consecutive month of expansion albeit at a softer pace, preliminary estimates showed.
The reading also came below market expectations of 50.9, as the manufacturing output index declined to 50.2 from 50.7, indicating only marginal growth in production.

title: France Manufacturing Expands Less Than Expected
